  t.ismfa = 1 as ismfa, t.isadmin = 1 as isadmin
from pg_catalog.pgaadauth_list_principals(false) t
where (not $1::boolean or t.rolname <> current_user)
  and not (t.rolname = any($2::text[]))
order by t.rolname
drop database if exists azpgaad_test_applydb with (force)
drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap1
drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap2
drop role if exists azpgaad_test_ap3
